title: Make a new wearable look of me from a person's outfit photographs
why: This is how the coat, the catsuit and the Home/Laidback 3 look were made. A photograph rarely shows the whole outfit in a pose a rigger can bind, so I first ask for an A-pose front and a turnaround in the same outfit, then build, rig, and put my own head on it.

params.photo: path of the main outfit photograph
params.views: panel order of the turnaround, e.g. left,back,right

steps.title: A-pose front view from the photograph
args: Full-body FRONT view of exactly this woman in exactly this outfit, standing straight in a relaxed A-pose, full body visible head to toe, plain light grey background. Keep every garment, accessory and hairstyle detail identical to the reference.
steps.why: Riggers need an A-pose; the photograph is usually a walk or a crop.

steps.title: Wait for the front view and download it
steps.why: Look at it before going on: if the outfit changed, stop.

steps.title: Left, back and right views of the same outfit
args: The same woman in exactly the same outfit, accessories and hairstyle, same A-pose, plain background. Show her from the left side, from the back, and from the right side, side by side, full body.
steps.why: Without the back the 3D build invents it (that is how the first coat got slits in its back).

steps.title: Cut the turnaround into one image per view
steps.why: multi-image-to-3d takes up to four separate views.

steps.title: Rig it with the same 24-bone humanoid skeleton as mine
Write the assemble job and put my head on
steps.why: Copy artifacts/foundry/m25c/v2/assemble-home_laidback3.job.json, set outfit to ${dir}/rigged.glb, headOffset = mean of (outfit neck − my neck) and (outfit Head − my Head) bone positions, cutZ = 1.465 + headOffset.z, hair = outfit. Then run lelu_m25c_lookassemble.py with it, render a bust, and look before registering.

steps.title: Add the look to m25c-wardrobe.ts and register it
steps.why: Then add words for it to LOOK_ALIASES in src/core/avatar/outfitCommand.ts so a person can ask for it, and write a journal entry.
